variants.cost: One scalar reward observation per round. Separately charge exact joint maximization, matrix update, positive definite solve and determinant/radius evaluation. No polynomial-time or total runtime bound is asserted.
variants.implementation_details_ref: s1: p.3 Figure 1 and Section 2; p.4 equation (1) and first ellipsoid in Theorem 2.
variants.name: Figure 1 OFUL with the first ellipsoid of Theorem 2
variants.output: Played actions, optimistic parameters, maintained ridge estimates and confidence sets. No final best-arm recommendation is extracted.
public_inputs: Integer d>=1; lambda>0; finite R>=0,S>=0; delta in (0,1); decision set D_t subset R^d revealed before each selection.
An attained measurable exact joint maximizer is required; no efficient implementation is supplied.
variants.query_and_update: For t>=1 choose (X_t,theta_tilde_t) in argmax_{(x,theta) in D_t x C_{t-1}} <x,theta>. Play X_t and observe one scalar Y_t. Update V_t=V_{t-1}+X_t X_t^T and b_t=b_{t-1}+X_tY_t; solve V_t theta_hat_t=b_t. Set r_t=R sqrt(2 log(det(V_t)^(1/2)/(lambda^(d/2)delta)))+sqrt(lambda)S and C_t={theta in R^d: ||theta_hat_t-theta||_{V_t}<=r_t}, where ||z||_A=sqrt(z^T A z).
variants.requirements: Fixed unknown theta_* in R^d with ||theta_*||_2<=S. For a filtration (F_t), X_t is F_{t-1}-measurable and eta_t is F_t-measurable. For every real u and t>=1, E[exp(u eta_t)|F_{t-1}]<=exp(u^2R^2/2) almost surely. Y_t=<X_t,theta_*>+eta_t. The selected optimistic maximizer must be predictable.
variants.state_and_initialization: V_0=lambda I_d, b_0=0, theta_hat_0=0. Evaluating the selected radius formula at t=0 gives r_0=R sqrt(2 log(1/delta))+sqrt(lambda)S and C_0={theta: ||theta||_{lambda I_d}<=r_0}. This initialization is formula evaluation, not a printed initialization line in Figure 1.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Fix lambda,R,S,delta before observations. Iterate t=1,2,..., or stop at an externally supplied horizon. No internal stopping rule is specified.
